questions.text: What is DigiVote, and how does it work?
questions.answer: DigiVote is a secure remote voting system that enables citizens to vote online using biometric authentication and blockchain technology.

questions.text: How does DigiVote enable remote voting?
questions.answer: It allows registered voters to log in, verify their identity, and cast votes from any location through a secure online system.

questions.text: How is DigiVote different from traditional voting?
questions.answer: DigiVote eliminates physical voting booths, allowing secure, location-independent, and tamper-proof elections.

questions.text: Why was DigiVote created?
questions.answer: To modernize elections, make voting more convenient, and prevent voter fraud using cutting-edge technology.

questions.text: What are the main features of DigiVote?
questions.answer:
Remote voting from any device

Biometric authentication

Blockchain-based vote security

Tamper-proof audit trail

Multi-factor authentication

questions.text: What makes DigiVote a secure voting platform?
questions.answer: It uses multi-factor authentication, blockchain security, encryption, and biometric verification.

questions.text: How does DigiVote improve voting accessibility?
questions.answer: It allows aged, disabled individuals, and people in remote areas to vote without physically visiting polling booths.

questions.text: Is DigiVote legally recognized for elections?
questions.answer: Yes, in jurisdictions where online voting is permitted.

questions.text: Has DigiVote been approved by the Election Commission?
questions.answer: DigiVote must be certified by national election authorities before use.

questions.text: What happens if DigiVote is banned in my country?
questions.answer: It cannot be used unless legal frameworks are changed.

questions.text: How do I cast my vote using DigiVote?
questions.answer:
Log in

Verify identity

Select candidate

Confirm and submit

questions.text: Can I change my vote after submitting it?
questions.answer: No, votes are final and cannot be altered.

questions.text: What if I make a mistake while voting?
questions.answer: Check carefully before submission. Once cast, votes are locked.

questions.text: How long does the voting process take?
questions.answer: Less than 5 minutes.

questions.text: Can I vote multiple times on DigiVote?
questions.answer: No, each voter is limited to one vote via biometric verification.

questions.text: Will I receive a confirmation after voting?
questions.answer: Yes, a receipt and digital token will be issued.

questions.text: Can I see a demo of the DigiVote process before election day?
questions.answer: Yes, a demo video feature is available.

questions.text: What if I move to another country after registering on DigiVote?
questions.answer: your registration will remain valid, but you can't able to vote you should be on the same location on the casting day of the vote.

questions.text: How does DigiVote prevent deepfake videos from tricking the system?
questions.answer: DigiVote employs liveness verification to prevent fraud.

questions.text: How does DigiVote ensure secure voting?
questions.answer: Using biometric authentication, blockchain storage, and encryption to prevent fraud.

questions.text: What security measures does DigiVote use?
questions.answer:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Biometric verification (face/fingerprint)

Blockchain immutability

questions.text: How does DigiVote prevent voter fraud?
questions.answer: By ensuring each vote is tied to a verified user through biometric authentication.

questions.text: What happens if someone tries to impersonate me?
questions.answer: The system will detect mismatched biometrics and block the attempt.

questions.text: Is DigiVote safe from hacking?
questions.answer: Yes, all votes are recorded on a tamper-proof blockchain.

questions.text: How does DigiVote handle biometric authentication?
questions.answer: Users must verify their fingerprint, facial scan, or iris scan before voting.

questions.text: Can DigiVote be tampered with?
questions.answer: No, blockchain technology prevents unauthorized changes.

questions.text: Can anyone see my voting history on DigiVote?
questions.answer: No, DigiVote ensures voter anonymity while allowing audits.

questions.text: How does DigiVote prevent deepfake videos from tricking the system?
questions.answer: DigiVote employs liveness verification to prevent fraud.

questions.text: Who can register for DigiVote?
questions.answer: Eligible citizens as per government election rules, including remote individual and disabled individuals.

questions.text: Can I vote using DigiVote if I live abroad?
questions.answer: NO, DigiVote supports citizens for remote voting in india only.

questions.text: What are the eligibility criteria for DigiVote?
questions.answer:
You must be:

A registered voter

Have a valid ID

Pass biometric authentication

questions.text: How do I sign up for DigiVote?
questions.answer: Visit the official DigiVote portal, submit identity documents, and complete biometric verification.

questions.text: What documents do I need to register for DigiVote?
questions.answer: A government-issued voter ID, Aadhaar card, or passport, depending on jurisdiction.

questions.text: How can I verify my eligibility for DigiVote?
questions.answer: Check the official voter eligibility test on the DigiVote portal.

questions.text: What is the registration deadline for DigiVote?
questions.answer: It varies based on election authorities. Check the official site.

questions.text: Can I register for DigiVote after the deadline?
questions.answer: No, registrations close before elections to ensure security and verification.

questions.text: How does DigiVote ensure secure voting?
questions.answer: Using biometric authentication, blockchain storage, and encryption to prevent fraud.

questions.text: How does DigiVote protect voter data?
questions.answer: Using encryption, secure cloud storage, and multi-factor authentication.

questions.text: Is my vote anonymous on DigiVote?
questions.answer: Yes, votes are anonymized and recorded on blockchain.

questions.text: Can the government see how I voted?
questions.answer: No, DigiVote ensures complete voter anonymity.

questions.text: What happens to my biometric data after voting?
questions.answer: It is not stored; it is only used for real-time authentication.

questions.text: Can my data be accessed by hackers?
questions.answer: No, all data is end-to-end encrypted and stored securely.

questions.text: Does DigiVote share voter data with third parties?
questions.answer: No, DigiVote does not share user data with external agencies.

questions.text: How long does DigiVote keep my data?
questions.answer: Only for the legally required duration, after which it is securely deleted.

questions.text: Why does DigiVote require OTP verification?
questions.answer: To add an extra layer of security before login.

questions.text: What happens if I don't receive my OTP?
questions.answer: Try again or use email verification instead.

questions.text: Can I use email verification instead of OTP?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote supports both SMS and email authentication.

questions.text: How does DigiVote verify my identity?
questions.answer: Through biometric authentication, Aadhaar/Voter ID, and multi-factor security.

questions.text: Can I use face recognition instead of fingerprints?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote supports facial, fingerprint, and iris recognition you have to pass any two of them.

questions.text: Can DigiVote detect fake biometric scans?
questions.answer: Yes

questions.text: What if someone else tries to use my identity?
questions.answer: DigiVote immediately blocks unauthorized attempts.

questions.text: Can I change my authentication method?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote allows multiple authentication options you have to verify atleast two of them.

questions.text: Can DigiVote be integrated with digital IDs?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote can be integrated with Aadhaar and Voter ID  identity systems to improve voter verification.

questions.text: Will DigiVote support multi-device authentication?
questions.answer: Yes, voters can authenticate using multiple devices such as phones, tablets, or laptops for flexibility.

questions.text: What should I do if I forget my DigiVote password?
questions.answer: Use the "Forgot Password" option, verify identity with OTP + biometrics, and reset it.

questions.text: How can I recover my DigiVote account?
questions.answer: Contact DigiVote support or use alternate authentication (email, biometrics, or ID verification).

questions.text: Who do I contact for technical issues?
questions.answer: DigiVote offers 24/7 support via chat, email, and helpline numbers.

questions.text: What devices are compatible with DigiVote?
questions.answer: It works on PCs, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

questions.text: Can I vote on DigiVote using my smartphone?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote is mobile-optimized and works on iOS and Android.

questions.text: Does DigiVote work on all browsers?
questions.answer: Yes, it supports Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, and Opera.

questions.text: Is there a mobile app for DigiVote?
questions.answer: Yes, DigiVote has official iOS and Android apps.

questions.text: Can I use DigiVote on public Wi-Fi safely?
questions.answer: Yes, but using a VPN or private network is recommended for added security.
